request: Implement all four replacements first; validate them in one grouped pass later.
target: Classic F411 / Cortex-M4; exact future image and UID must be bound freshly

HOST.build_only: Use --build-only to compile/export the complete package without importing or constructing Unicorn.
HOST.grouped_execution: One command without --build-only compiles all variants, compares F401/M0 fallback bodies, and executes the full deterministic HOST semantic pass once. First failure stops the pass and is retained without retry.
HOST.ARM_engine: tests/unicorn_runtime.py::Uc with the normal host guard; HOST times are not hardware measurements.
HOST.SDK_runtime: Only strncat has an existing slot: unchanged runtime26 slot21 and the real SDK runtime.S tail. No new slots or ABI changes.
HOST.copy_append_alignments: All16 source/destination byte-alignment pairs; strnlen has all4 source alignments.
HOST.memory: Source SRAM and Flash; writable destination SRAM; source and destination envelopes have head/tail canaries. No overlapping copy buffers, which would be outside the ISO C contracts.
HOST.counts: Zero, one, just before/at/after NUL, longer than source, bounded unterminated source. SIZE_MAX only with terminated strnlen/strncat inputs; no invalid enormous strncpy destination.
semantics: strnlen: exact minimum of n and first NUL; no source read for n0 or after the first NUL/n.
strcpy: copy through exactly the terminating NUL and return the original destination.
strncpy: exactly n output bytes including mandatory zero padding; no added NUL when n is exhausted before the terminator; no source access after its first NUL.
strncat: preserve destination prefix, append at most n nonzero source bytes and one terminating NUL; return original destination.
Candidate n0 strncat additionally touches neither pointer; this extra no-touch guarantee is not required of the original C control.
All source reads are individual bytes, without prefix/word speculation. strncpy padding may make aligned word stores only entirely within its n-byte destination envelope.
Check source immutability, all destination canaries, AAPCS r4-r11/SP, PRIMASK and CONTROL.
